verdict.rationale: The evidence shows recurring subscription charges ([stripe-billing-docs-31], [stripe-billing-docs-1]) and a brief mention of 'Billing automations' for customer communications ([stripe-billing-docs-24]). None of it documents a way to schedule arbitrary recurring jobs or workflows. A recurring billing cycle is a fixed billing behavior, not a user-defined recurring schedule, and the automations mention gives no scheduling detail, so this is adjacent rather than direct support.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
